commandsRun: agent-browser dev-rail UI flow for xAI picker, key modal, tools toggle, and send attempts

assertions.title: xAI custom endpoints auto-detect and refresh live models with aliases

steps.action: Open model picker and inspect xAI endpoint before saving any xAI key.
steps.expected: xAI endpoint is recognized and bootstrap models are available before key save.
steps.observed: xAI appears in picker with bootstrap models (grok-4-0709, grok-4.20-beta-latest-non-reasoning, grok-4.20-beta-latest-reasoning, grok-3-mini, grok-code-fast-1).

steps.action: Execute xAI chat turn and verify key presence via API.
steps.expected: With valid key, runtime refresh/alias checks can proceed.
steps.observed: GET /api/keys?name=xai returned 200 with {"expiresAt":null}; xAI send attempts returned UI error 'No key found. Please provide a key and try again.'

evidence.network: api-endpoints-response.json -> xai custom endpoint present; api-models-response.json -> xai model list present; api-keys-xai.json -> {"expiresAt":null}; VAL-PROVIDER-007-chat-body-text.txt -> 'No key found. Please provide a key and try again.'

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing xAI user credential in this partition; refresh-from-/v1/language-models and alias-preservation validation cannot be completed.

assertions.title: xAI settings stay capability-aware and sanitize unsupported runtime params

steps.action: Open xAI key/settings entrypoint from model picker.
steps.expected: xAI settings surface is reachable and runtime validation can proceed with valid key.
steps.observed: xAI Set API Key dialog is reachable, but xAI execution still reports no key at runtime.

steps.action: Attempt xAI runtime request required to observe unsupported-parameter sanitization.
steps.expected: Successful xAI request allows parameter-shaping verification.
steps.observed: Runtime stops with 'No key found. Please provide a key and try again.' so unsupported-param stripping remains unobservable.

evidence.network: api-keys-xai.json -> {"expiresAt":null}; runtime failure captured in VAL-PROVIDER-007-chat-body-text.txt

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing xAI key on the tested persona; runtime parameter sanitization path is unreachable.

assertions.title: xAI native web search strips only the intended generic tool

steps.action: Select xAI model and enable Web Search from tools menu.
steps.expected: xAI web-search path becomes testable for strip-only validation.
steps.observed: Web Search toggle was enabled in UI and xAI turn was submitted.

steps.action: Inspect xAI runtime behavior for native strip semantics.
steps.expected: Request executes so generic web_search stripping can be confirmed.
steps.observed: Turn failed before provider execution with 'No key found. Please provide a key and try again.'; strip behavior could not be proven.

evidence.network: VAL-PROVIDER-008A-web-search-chat-body-text.txt shows xAI execution failed with missing-key error before request-level tool-strip verification.

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing xAI credential; request-level native web-search strip behavior remains untestable.

assertions.title: Ollama model discovery merges multiple sources and resolves per-model origin

steps.action: Inspect Ollama/Ollama Cloud discovery via model picker and /api/models.
steps.observed: UI and API show populated lists for both ollama (12) and Ollama Cloud (16) models.

steps.action: Verify per-model origin mapping and tags->models fallback observability from allowed user/API surface.
steps.expected: Surface exposes model-to-origin mapping and fallback diagnostics.
steps.observed: Available surfaces only expose flat model ID arrays; no per-model origin metadata or fallback diagnostics were observable.

evidence.network: api-models-response.json and api-models-specs_true.json/details_true.json/format_full.json all return string arrays (no origin fields); api-endpoints-response.json shows endpoint-level config only.

assertions.issues: Blocked by observability limits of the assigned user/API surface: per-model origin routing and explicit /api/tags fallback behavior cannot be proven from exposed data.

frictions.description: agent-browser wait --load networkidle timed out on /login.
frictions.resolution: Switched to fixed wait before screenshots for this flow.

frictions.description: Tools popup dismiss button was blocked by overlay during interaction.
frictions.resolution: Used Escape key to close popup and continue the flow.

blockers.description: xAI credential is not usable for the validation persona in this dev partition.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Verified xAI key status via GET /api/keys?name=xai (200 {"expiresAt":null}) and retried xAI sends; UI consistently returned 'No key found. Please provide a key and try again.'

blockers.description: Per-model origin mapping/fallback diagnostics for Ollama are not exposed on allowed user/API surfaces.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Cross-checked UI picker lists plus /api/models variants and /api/endpoints; only endpoint-level and flat model-ID data were available.

summary: Tested 4 assigned assertions on dev rail: 0 passed, 4 blocked (VAL-PROVIDER-007/008/008A/009). xAI discovery/bootstrap visibility is present, but xAI execution paths are blocked by missing usable user key, and Ollama per-model origin proof remains blocked by unavailable origin/fallback telemetry on the exposed user/API surface.
